title: Braised Shiitake Carrot Futomaki
description: Earthy mushrooms glazed with soy and mirin, contrasting with carrot and cucumber.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: Slice mushrooms and simmer with soy sauce, mirin and honey until tender and the liquid has reduced to a glossy coating.
Blanch carrot briefly, then cool and dry. Cut cucumber into slender batons.
Spread a moderately thin rice layer over nori; arrange cooled mushrooms, carrot and cucumber in thick strips.
Roll firmly, cut eight generous pieces per roll and scatter sesame lightly.
notes: Although plant-based, this version has a rich umami profile from the mushrooms.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
